rooms.name: The first cracked shelf
rooms.lesson: Cracked ice gives way · prepare on the stone. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: Across the thaw pools
rooms.lesson: The thaw has broken the old continuous ice road. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The thawing viaduct
rooms.lesson: Leave the cracked spans before they fall. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The meltwater culvert
rooms.lesson: Keep jumps small beneath the culvert roof. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The exposed rock climb
rooms.lesson: The rock holds while the ice below breaks. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: Where the ice lets go
rooms.lesson: One final chain of fragile frozen shelves. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
